kernel_guard_path_v1.cause: The queue passed a project-relative output path to a guard that expects a PoC-relative path.
kernel_guard_path_v1.effect: The model output and guard/profile output used separate directories. The physical run completed.
kernel_guard_path_v1.resolution: The controller stopped without interrupting the GPU job. Distinct guard and profile files moved without replacement after completion.

eager_source_v1.cause: Many physical layers share one RoPE module. The observer installed repeated wrappers on that object.
eager_source_v1.effect: The diagnostic exceeded its bounded event pool. No result from this failed run enters latency summaries.
eager_source_v1.resolution: The observer now installs one hook per object and method. A separate v2 directory retains any new attempt.
